# Cycle 003: bounded visual JSON format correction

## Measured bottleneck
Cycle 002 at 179bde5 ran exactly once with input/ and unchanged deepseek-flash configuration. The third visual response ended with stop but contained unescaped quotes around Login in its style string (JSON error char 3429). Stage 01 stopped: 48.162 outer seconds, 10,052 actual tokens, 3/3 usage, 3 HTTP attempts, no HTTP retries. First two responses were valid. No application or original scenario executed. Evidence: .agent/benchmarks/cycle-002-baseline.json and output/cycle-002-baseline-20261031-153234/model_calls.jsonl. This is a model output format failure, not an environment failure or transport truncation.

## Minimal scope
Read required skills, scheduler README, writeup and private project conventions without displaying credentials. Inspect VisualModel.analyze and its existing invocation logging. Add at most ONE corrective visual request ONLY after JSONDecodeError. Give the model the specific parse error and explicit JSON escaping correction instruction, keeping the same image and layout/elements/style contract. Keep the first failed response and every corrective request logged through invoke. Do not heuristically edit JSON, accept partial evidence, retry authentication/network/refusal/truncation/schema failures, relax validators, change model/input/.env or global SDK retry defaults. A second malformed result must fail. If implementation inspection shows a better equally small solution, document the reason before changing scope; no broad retry framework.
